blockList.title: Block lists
blockList.subtitle: IP addresses, IP ranges, email domains and countries the fraud check always flags.
blockList.added: Entry added to the block list.
blockList.removed: Entry removed from the block list.
blockList.deleteMessage: {value} will no longer be flagged by the fraud check.

log.title: Fraud log
log.subtitle: Every registration and order the fraud check scored, with its decision and the reasons behind it.

settings.title: Fraud settings
settings.subtitle: Choose when an order waits for review and when an action is refused at once.
settings.enabledHint: When off, registrations and orders are not scored and nothing is held for review.

manualReviewRiskScore.label: Review threshold
manualReviewRiskScore.hint: From this risk score, from 0 to 100, an order waits for staff review.

autoRejectRiskScore.label: Auto reject threshold
autoRejectRiskScore.hint: From this risk score, from 0 to 100, an action is refused at once. It must be above the review threshold.

velocityWindowMinutes.label: Velocity window (minutes)
velocityWindowMinutes.hint: How far back orders from one IP address are counted, from 1 to 1440 minutes.

velocityMaxOrders.label: Orders allowed in the window
velocityMaxOrders.hint: More orders than this from one IP address inside the window raise the risk.

maxAccountsPerIp.label: Accounts allowed per IP address
maxAccountsPerIp.hint: More accounts than this from one IP address raise the risk.

errors.scoreRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
errors.reviewBelowReject: Must be lower than the auto reject threshold.
errors.windowRange: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1440.
errors.countRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
